paragraphs: I'm Laura. If you've tried everything to heal your mental and emotional health
I get it.  I did too. Medication. Talk therapy. Rehab. Psychiatric care. I did the work that was supposed to work.  Years in
I felt defeated. None of it reached what was actually there. Unprocessed emotion and stored trauma

living in my body. Not just my mind.  Then I found breathwork. My nervous system started to regulate. Emotions I had carried for years finally had somewhere to go. It was the first thing that worked at the level I needed.  So I left my master's program in psychology. I left my career in dual diagnosis. I went all in. I had seen what happens when someone stops managing and masking their pain and starts moving through it.  Today I have nearly five years of breathwork experience. I've coached over 100 people. I've led over 70 events and more than a dozen retreats around the world. I bring a mental health background and lived experience into every session.  I don't offer quick symptom relief or coping tricks. We take a holistic approach with a strong emphasis on nervous system regulation.
pullQuote: I don't provide symptom relief or coping strategies. We dive into a holistic approach that creates actual transformation.
